original_problems: C7 target mismatch: concept B has connected gabled/hipped frontages and a tightly framed civic space. The final shares broad landmark positions but replaces those masses with repeated flat facade bands, fine-textured roof carpets and large paved gaps. It does not clearly achieve the chosen concept's coherence.

Structure/FIXES 1/3: the square is not enclosed on all four sides. The 192 px market at x816..1008/y1056..1200 leaves broad open sides (roughly x624..816 and x1008..1200); the church at x528..768 is isolated in paving instead of joining the western square edge. The southern square reads as an apron with a small pavilion.

Structure/FIXES 1/4/5/11: northwest and southern ring interiors are covered with flat repeated roof texture rather than coherent pitched rear wings and roof contacts. See x240..432/y432..624 and the southwest/southeast roof fields around y1008..1296. Filling owned cells has not produced a believable perimeter block in the actual render.

FIXES 16 / BRIEF row-of-five limit: five consecutive northeast lots beginning x1248,1344,1440,1536,1632 repeat the same ground-north-w2-c7r1 and storey-north-w2-c7r1 at the same heights. Similar repeated north-facing facade runs occur in the northwest/civic blocks. Alternating the roof does not fix five identical ground/storey pieces.

FIXES 9/20: the brown foreground roof at x1536..1632/y960 cuts off the tailor sign's scissors handles and the lower board. It reads as a V instead of scissors. The asset itself is legible; its city placement fails.
FIXES 12: the turn below the fountain contains a visible rectangular patch of smaller/differently arranged cobbles at (1053,957). Kerb continuity does not conceal the surface mismatch.

FIXES 13: the continuous north curtain casts a repeated row of detached trapezoids at y192..240 with bright gaps between same-height wall modules. This is still a pattern of clipped shadow mats rather than a continuous wall shadow stepped by actual towers/stairs.

FIXES 18/19: the northwest activity labelled laundry is visually a small roofed shed beside the well, with no washing line/rack; the worker has no readable laundry task. The northeast sorting table at x1536/base480 is buried by the foreground roof in the normal render.

Landmark/squint failure: the guildhall is no taller than the adjacent five-storey stacks and competes with their repeated window bands; the small market and south gate do not establish the hierarchy visible in concept B. A correct canvas size does not waive the brief's landmark-dominance rule.
